newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair to meet Ford for talks Thursday.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair to meet Ford for talks Thursday.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair is to meet the board of Ford Motor Co of the U.S. on Thursday in a bid to push forward his drive for better cooperation with business.
Sources in Blair's offices said Blair expected to discuss the government's plans for a University for Industry to enhance adult education through public-private partnership.

A spokeswoman for Ford said the board, including chairman Alex Trotman, would also hope to address "areas of mutual concern", including the climate for investment in Britain, at the London meeting. A statement would be issued by the company after the meeting.

Ford would be also stressing the company's commitment to Britain, she said, adding that the meeting was important but not unprecedented as the board had held talks in the past with previous serving British prime ministers.

Ford averted the threat of a national strike over job cuts by British workers earlier this year after agreeing a deal with unions. The deal cut the number of expected job losses at Ford's Halewood plant in northwest England from 1,300 to 980.
But Ford has been pushing for increased government help to ensure the future of the Halewood plant. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7768
